svg.title: Paper Trail: every claim has a receipt
svg.desc: Paper Trail is a private, evidence-backed contribution graph of your engineering work, for performance-review conversations. The picture shows a grid of weeks by weekdays coloured by day rating (exceeds, meets, needs improvement, no data), a selected week 47 with a receipt-style popover reading Exceeds, 3 shipped, 2 decisions and evidence ids, and a side panel with the week's intent and four commitments marked Hit, Hit, Partial and Missed, with a plan-accuracy trend. All data is fictional.

g.text: A private, evidence-backed contribution graph for your review conversations.
